Priya: FYI 10: Incident RCA for the intermittent tokenization regression is published: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2065432100-tokenizer-regression
Priya: TL;DR: new tokenizer packaging changed BPE merge order in a minor release, edge cases caused ~0.5% hallucination increase for long-form prompts. Impact window ~45m, some customers saw degraded quality.
Priya: RCA + timeline + raw request samples (anonymized) are in the doc. Please read before the follow-up checkpoint.
Liam: Thanks 10. Who owns the patch to pin tokenizer packaging and the rollout plan?
Priya: Action items called out in the doc (section: Owners & Targets):
- Rafael 10 12 12 12: pin tokenizer build artifact and add CI smoke checks 12 target 2026-04-08
- Nina 10 12: add an automated eval for long-form hallucination rate and tie to release gating 12 target 2026-04-03
- Priya 10 12: update support FAQ & outbound comms template 12 target 2026-03-30
Priya: Also added a short rollback playbook and a canary checklist. Please comment if you see gaps.
Rafael: I'll own the artifact pinning. I'll open the patch and include a reproducible unit test. Planning to target a staged rollout behind canary in eu-central-1.
Nina: I'll build the eval harness and add it as a nightly job. Suggest we capture two metrics: hallucination-rate-long and perplexity-delta.
Liam: Ops ask: can we get a list of affected customers for prioritization? Also recommend adding an alert on sudden metric drift for the long-hallucination metric.
Priya: @Liam added customer-impact table to the doc. Rafael, can you include a note for support on detection steps?
Rafael: Added detection snippet in the doc (sample query + thresholds). Patch PR #1103 coming shortly.
OpsBot: Incident recorded: INC-7890 12 https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-7890
Liam: Scheduling a 20-min checkpoint tomorrow 09:30 PT to validate PR and rollout plan. Calendar invite: https://calendar.internal/meet/tokenizer-check
Priya: If you can't make it, drop your comments in the doc. We'll need a sign-off from Eng-ML and Eng-SRE before canary.
Nina: Noted. I'll post the initial eval graphs to the doc once CI runs.
Rafael: PR opened, added test artifacts and backout plan. Tagging @eng-ml for review.
Priya: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Once we have the canary stable for 24h we'll close the incident and publish a short external note.
Liam: +1. Adding runbook item: add a "tokenizer artifact change" check to release checklist.
Priya: Thanks everyone. Please ack in the doc when your action is complete. :thumbsup:
